name: Belgium

call.label: Ambulance and fire
call.note: Free to call anywhere in Europe.

call.label: Doctor on duty
call.when: Ill, and your own doctor is shut
call.note: For medical problems that cannot wait for your own doctor's surgery hours.

call.label: Non-urgent fire help in a storm
call.when: Storm or flood damage that isn't urgent
call.note: Active only during a storm. The website 1722.be is always open.

call_notes.text: Don't call 112 for ordinary storm damage. Use the website 1722.be instead.

alerts.text: BE-Alert: a mayor, a provincial governor or the Interior Minister can send you a text, a voice call or an e-mail. Registering is free, and so are the messages.

If your phone is connected to a mast in the risk zone you get a text without registering. Registering also reaches you when you are away from home, and you can add up to five addresses, such as a workplace or a relative's home.
A municipality that is not yet on BE-Alert can still reach you through the governor of its province. If the phone network is jammed, the authorities use other channels.

first_steps.text: Register at be-alert.be before you need it.

authorities.name: FPS Home Affairs, 112.be
authorities.role: Runs the 112 emergency number and lists the other emergency numbers.

authorities.name: National Crisis Centre
authorities.role: Publishes the risks in Belgium, what the authorities do and what you can do.

authorities.name: BE-Alert
authorities.role: The national alert system. Mayors, governors and the Interior Minister send alerts through it.

authorities.name: Belgian Poison Centre
authorities.role: Advice on poisoning, around the clock.

hazards.text: Floods along the rivers and on reclaimed coastal land, which concrete dikes protect from the sea.
The National Crisis Centre lists storms, floods, forest fires and heatwaves as natural risks.
It also lists an incident at a nuclear plant, a traffic accident and a marine accident as technological risks.

climate.text: Temperate: mild winters, cool summers, and often rainy, humid and cloudy.
